title: Give My Quartz Back
description: Just a simple datapack to get your quartz back from blocks
body:
# Give My Quartz Back
Little datapack to get quartz from quartz blocks

## Features
- Convert quartz blocks into quartz
- Give 4 quartz for each block
- Chiseled Quartz Block, Quartz Block, Quartz Bricks, Quartz Pillar

![Quartz craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/yymBkfjO/images/29bc40ab60abed474b59eded344645e41e8479dd.png)

## Installation
1. Download the data pack .zip file
2. Drop the file .zip into `datapacks` folder of your world
3. Launch your world (or reload using `/reload` if already in game)
